name: va_tower_twin
notes: Two brothers' tower-houses 4.5 m square with a 1 m gap between them, joined by a covered timber bridge at 18 m: the west one 26.5 m with cobalt tile, the east one 23.5 m with saffron bands, both with stepped crenellations. Doors are on local -Z under striped awnings; stairs climb eight and seven floors to flat roofs with 1.25 m parapets. White limewash with cobalt trim since v2.
